name: Vaultline
tagline: Messages only the two of you can read.
features: Real WebCrypto end-to-end encryption: ECDH P-256 key agreement into an AES-GCM-256 key, fresh 96-bit IV per message
A relay-server panel that only ever shows IV and ciphertext, with a tamper switch that makes decryption fail
Safety number from SHA-256 over both public keys, computed on each side and cross-checked
Non-extractable private keys, regenerated per session or on demand
Honest copy: keys stay in this tab; demo, not an audited product
